instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Management consulting firm serving mid-market companies with strategy, operational excellence, and digital transformation engagements. The firm operates within regulated industries like IT and finance, requiring careful adherence to data privacy and industry compliance standards when handling sensitive client information.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring to streamline client acquisition.
answers.strategicGoals: We are targeting a 20% improvement in operational throughput without increasing headcount. Our processes have grown organically over the years and are overdue for standardization. We suspect that workflow digitization, basic automation, and better data integration between our core systems can unlock significant productivity gains within our current cost structure.
answers.additionalContext: Prime Networks operates in a competitive landscape where larger firms are increasingly leveraging proprietary AI tools for rapid proposal generation and service scoping, forcing smaller players to prioritize process automation over manual execution.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Workflow Automation for Proposal Generation
opportunities.rationale: Implementing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) or low-code tools to handle the repetitive tasks of drafting standard proposals and service scopes will directly address the efficiency goal. This leverages existing process knowledge while reducing consultant hours spent on administrative overhead.

first_actions: Identify top 3 most manual proposal tasks for automation mapping
Pilot a tool like Zapier or Microsoft Power Automate for data integration between CRM and document templates
Create a phased rollout plan targeting the sales team first
resources_needed: Internal developer time allocation of 10 hours per week
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in proposal drafting time by 40% within Q3.
milestones: Q2: Tool selection and pilot completion (Month 1-2)
Q3: Full deployment of automated workflow for standardized engagements (Month 3-5)

opportunities.title: Generative AI for Initial Scoping & Strategy Drafting
opportunities.rationale: Integrate an enterprise-grade Large Language Model (LLM) trained on proprietary case studies and industry best practices to automatically generate first drafts of strategic roadmaps. This radically changes the initial engagement phase from purely manual research to a hybrid human/AI loop.

first_actions: Establish a secure, private LLM environment (e.g., Azure OpenAI or dedicated service)
Develop fine-tuned prompts based on historical successful proposals
Integrate the AI tool into the consultant's daily workflow for initial scoping documents
resources_needed: API usage costs for LLM services (variable, estimated $1k/month)
Specialized prompt engineering expertise or external advisory (budget allocation: 2%)
Data security audit of the LLM environment
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in proposal win rate by 15% due to faster, higher-quality scoping documents.
milestones: Q3: Internal proof-of-concept and successful testing with internal teams (Month 3)
Q4: Pilot deployment for all new mid-market engagements (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Knowledge Management System Overhaul
opportunities.rationale: Transition from ad-hoc documentation to a centralized, searchable knowledge base (KB) integrated directly into the project management workflow. This addresses the 'time' barrier by ensuring institutional knowledge is accessible instantly.

first_actions: Select and configure a lightweight KM platform (e.g., Notion or Confluence integration)
Mandate new documentation standards for all project managers
Train consultants on mandatory KB contribution protocols
resources_needed: Platform licensing fee (low cost SaaS tier)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in 'rework' time by 25% as measured by project managers.
milestones: Q1: System selection and foundational KB structure setup (Month 1)
Q2: Full team migration to the new KM system (Month 3)

next_steps.action: Launch a cross-functional working group to define the KPIs and budget for the Generative AI scoping tool pilot.
Finalize technical requirements and security protocols for the new Knowledge Management System (KM).
Allocate dedicated time slots for 'innovation cycles' within developer schedules to ensure continuous low-level improvement.

key_weaknesses: Lack of specialized technical talent, forcing generalists to wear multiple hats.
Highly informal decision-making process which risks inconsistent scaling and slow adoption of new processes.
Low digital maturity (Level 2) resulting in fragmented systems requiring constant manual bridging between tools.
